[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-18i[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Approve any tale plan file from the CLI[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase plan approve <plan>` commits and approves a tale plan the way[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sase's TUI does — through its live approval gate when one exists, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and otherwise by committing the plan itself and launching a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`#coder` agent into the planner's agent family, or as a standalone [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent when no family can be found. `-k/--kind` defaults to `tale`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and every success, dry run, refusal, and failure prints a clear, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]colored summary.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Direct approval engine[/bold #D7AFFF]                                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]engine: add the backend for approving a plan with no live gate. This [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]covers archive and adoption helpers, direct-approval receipts wired into[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plan history and `sase plan list`, the gate-history classifier, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolver/decision model with `#coder` prompt composition, the executor, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and coder follow-up fields on gate approval results.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]CLI routing, output, and docs[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: default `--kind` to tale with an epic guard, and add `-n/--dry-run`[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and `-P/--project`. Route live gates and gateless plans through one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handler, render one approval card for every outcome, and update help, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs, and CLI tests.[/#D7D7AF]
